description_en: One rattan and bamboo household product. Front: A broad shallow round basket has an open mesh bamboo base raised on a low ring. Side: The curved rim is strengthened by two continuous bamboo hoops. Rear: The rear underside displays radial support ribs and an open drainage gap. Smooth bound joints, visibly interlaced natural fibers, empty clean inserts where specified. No writing, numbers, logos, marks, labels or other objects.
